test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined word.

There are so many __flies__ on the food.

options.text: To hover up in the sky
To move from one place to another

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **Insects with wings**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"flies"** refers to small insects with wings. (मक्खियाँ)

 
 
• **Example: **There were several flies buzzing around the picnic area.
 
 
 
• **"Insects with wings"** means small creatures that can fly using their wings. (पंख वाले कीड़े)
 
 
• **Example: **Butterflies, flies, and bees are all insects with wings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**
